title: Repair the 10-unit boundary
prompt: Repair compute_price so the 10-unit bulk tier starts at exactly 10 units, preserves the 50-unit tier, and still adds customer discounts. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.

title: Repair the 50-unit boundary
prompt: Repair compute_price so the 50-unit bulk tier starts at exactly 50 units. Preserve lower tiers, integer-cent rounding, and additive customer discounts. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.

title: Preserve additive premium/bulk discounts
prompt: Repair compute_price: bulk and customer discounts add as percentage points before one integer-cent calculation; they are not alternatives or sequential discounts. Preserve all bulk boundaries. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.

title: Reject negative quantities while allowing zero
prompt: Make compute_price reject every negative quantity with ValueError before pricing, while allowing zero and preserving prices for positive quantities. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.

title: Clamp combined discounts at 100%
prompt: Make compute_price cap the combined bulk and extra discount at 100 percent so over-discounted orders cost zero, never a negative amount. Preserve additive discounts below 100 percent and integer-cent rounding. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.

title: Restore coupon whitespace/case handling
prompt: Restore coupon_percent normalization: ignore surrounding whitespace and letter case for every known coupon, and return zero for unknown or empty codes. Preserve apply_coupon integer-cent rounding. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.

title: Reject nonpositive reservations
prompt: Make Inventory.reserve reject zero and negative quantities with ValueError without changing stock or reservations. Preserve positive reservations and OutOfStock for insufficient stock. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.

title: Preserve stock on failed reservation
prompt: Repair Inventory.reserve so an insufficient-stock attempt raises OutOfStock and changes neither stock nor existing reservations. Subsequent valid reservations and releases must still work, including unknown SKUs. Keep existing tests and configuration unchanged.
